sources: https://anc.apm.activecommunities.com/mecklenburgparks/reservation/landing/search?locale=en-US&keyword=mcdowell%20campground&eventTypeIds=30 (Mecklenburg County's ActiveNet booking site; site records via its rest/reservation/resource/detail API for RV sites R1-R5, R7-R13 and drive-to site D3)

hookups.source: ActiveNet site records, read 2026-10-22: every RV site 'Electricity: 50/30/20amps' with water at the site; R 5 '(35ft or less- Full Hookup)', 'Sewer Hookup: Yes'; the other RV sites '(… No Sewer)'

values.note: 56 sites: 13 RV sites (paved pull-throughs with water and 20/30/50-amp power, posted for rigs of 25 to 38 ft, one of them R12 '25ft or less' with a 20-ft size line; only R5 has sewer), 33 drive-to sites with 26 x 11 ft pads, shared water and 20/30-amp power (offered for 'Conversion Van Camping'), and 10 primitive sites.

sites.source: https://parkandrec.mecknc.gov/Places-to-Visit/Camping ('a 56-site campground ... 33 drive up sites, 10 primitive sites and 13 RV sites') + ActiveNet site records (names 'R 1 (30ft or less- No Sewer)' to 'R13', 'RV Size Accommodated', 'Site is paved and pull-through'; D3 'Pad: 26ft X 11ft', 'Electricity: 30/20amps', amenity 'Conversion Van Camping'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: ActiveNet site records ('McDowell Campground features a centrally located restroom/showerhouse with hot and cold running water, flush toilets, and laundry room'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online on Mecklenburg County's ActiveNet site up to 182 days ahead and as late as an hour before; 14 nights at most. The full-hookup site R5 needs 2 nights; the other RV sites take 1. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon. Camping contact (980) 314-2267.

booking.source: ActiveNet site records' Reservation Rules ('Minimum reservation time: 1 night' / R5 '2 nights', 'Maximum reservation time: 14 nights', 'Residents can make reservations at least 1 hour(s) in advance but not more than 182 day(s) in advance', same for non-residents, 'fixed check-in time of 3:00 PM and a fixed check-out time of 12:00 PM') + https://parkandrec.mecknc.gov/Places-to-Visit/Camping (contact 980-314-2267), read 2026-10-22

note: Mecklenburg County Park & Rec nature preserve on Lake Wylie SW of Charlotte. --Claude
summary: County camping page and its ActiveNet booking site: confirmed 56 sites, 13 paved pull-through RV sites to 38 ft with water and 50-amp (one, R5, full hookup), showers/flush toilets/laundry, online booking; added the 182-day window, 14-night max, R5's 2-night minimum (booking note). Fees ($35 resident RV rate) stand. Note trimmed to what no field holds. Not stated: season, dump station.
flags: Fees: the stored nightly_high $40 is the NON-RESIDENT RV rate ('RV Sites $35 (R) $40 (NR)'); by the schema the base is the resident $35 and the $5 difference belongs in fees.nonresident. Not changed (fees provenance is a human check, 2026-10-15).

Phone: the county's camping contact is (980) 314-2267 (Camping page: 'For all information on our camping opportunities, please contact ... 980-314-2267'); the entry's 980-314-1128 is the nature preserve's number.
Name: the county calls the campground 'McDowell Campground' (within McDowell Nature Preserve).
